description: This Java class defines the domain model for a loan overdue installment charge within a loan management system. It maps to the 'm_loan_overdue_installment_charge' database table and includes references to related entities such as LoanCharge and LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment, with methods to create and update instances.

classes.name: LoanOverdueInstallmentCharge
classes.description: Represents an overdue installment charge related to a specific loan and installment schedule, including its frequency number.

methods.name: LoanOverdueInstallmentCharge (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LoanOverdueInstallmentCharge with specified loan charge, installment, and frequency number.

methods.name: updateLoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment
methods.description: Updates the installment associated with this overdue charge.
